verdict.rationale: Raygun's access-token docs list "Sending dSYMS to Raygun" and "Uploading ProGuard mapping files" as supported services, so first-party dSYM and ProGuard upload is documented. That evidence is only a passing mention on a token page, though; there is no dedicated upload guide and no confirmation of how mobile crashes are symbolicated. Missing for 10: upload of native debug symbols (e.g. Breakpad/PDB/ELF), a documented upload workflow or CLI, evidence that iOS/Android crashes resolve to function names and line numbers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload dSYM, ProGuard, and native debug symbols so mobile and native crashes symbolicate to real function names and lines

citations.quote: You'll need your external access token for the following services: Deployments API, Sending dSYMS to Raygun, Uploading ProGuard mapping files
